text:
To find the average height of the heels, we calculate the total height and divide by the number of people wearing them:

Total height = $(3 \times 4\text{ inches}) + (3 \times 2\text{ inches}) = 12 + 6 = 18\text{ inches}$
Total number of women = $3 + 3 = 6$

Average height = $\frac{18\text{ inches}}{6} = 3\text{ inches}$

ANSWER: 3
